title: 供应商发票与付款核对
learningObjective: 能够按发票核对净应付、截止日前付款及余额，并区分四种付款状态。
concept: 净应付=原始面额−截至截止日已批准贷项；余额=净应付−已付金额。已结清不等于一定付现，贷项可能抵销全部面额。发票与付款通常一对多，贷项也是独立明细，直接连接会形成乘积。
syntax: SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,CASE WHEN balance_cents=0 THEN 'paid' WHEN paid_cents=0 THEN 'unpaid' WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'overpaid' END payment_state FROM v_invoice_balance ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,supplier_invoice_id

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

mysqlSql: SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,CASE WHEN balance_cents=0 THEN 'paid' WHEN paid_cents=0 THEN 'unpaid' WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'overpaid' END payment_state FROM v_invoice_balance ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,supplier_invoice_id
sqliteSql: SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,CASE WHEN balance_cents=0 THEN 'paid' WHEN paid_cents=0 THEN 'unpaid' WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'overpaid' END payment_state FROM v_invoice_balance ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,supplier_invoice_id
useCase: 财务应付人员核对截至2025-12-31的发票。原视图已包含截止日规则；示例用独立付款及贷项汇总复现其含义。金额为马币分。原状态规则先判余额为零，再判付款为零，之后判断余额正负。若允许贷项超过面额且无付款，应单独审核负余额分类。
comparison: 采购订单金额核对按采购订单粒度；付款核对按发票粒度。余额不等于原始面额减所有历史付款。

commonError.example: 把付款与贷项明细直接连接后累计，或使用付款日超过截止日的记录。
commonError.correction: 独立预聚合并统一截止日；保留贷项审批状态及原始面额供审计。

notes: 完整输出见 ../enterprise_reference/business_tasks/results/BP17.json；公开预览展示前12行。独立边界及场景仅在提交判题时使用。

compatibility.detail: 本版本SQLite及sql.js WASM已实际复验，原生MySQL8.4尚未执行。

mergedFrom.title: 采购：发票与订单金额核对

teaching.problem: 财务应付人员核对截至2025-12-31的发票。原视图已包含截止日规则；示例用独立付款及贷项汇总复现其含义。金额为马币分。原状态规则先判余额为零，再判付款为零，之后判断余额正负。若允许贷项超过面额且无付款，应单独审核负余额分类。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先按发票编号 GROUP BY 两组明细；LEFT JOIN 保留无付款或无贷项的发票；COALESCE 将不存在的汇总记录视为零。CASE 按顺序判断状态，不能先判付款为零，否则全额贷项抵销会被误报为未付。
teaching.resultExplanation: 发票1面额10000、贷项2000、已付5000，余额3000；跨年付款不计。发票2未付5000；发票3已结清；发票4多付500；发票5全额贷项抵销，没有现金付款仍结清。原企业预览发票252余额1095304分，需结合到期日判断紧急程度。

checkpoints.name: invoice_balance
checkpoints.label: 核对发票的开票、已付和剩余金额
checkpoints.sql:
SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents
FROM v_invoice_balance ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: payment_classification
checkpoints.label: 按余额及付款额划分付款状态
checkpoints.sql:
SELECT supplier_invoice_id,balance_cents,
 CASE WHEN balance_cents=0 THEN 'paid' WHEN paid_cents=0 THEN 'unpaid'
      WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'overpaid' END AS payment_state
FROM v_invoice_balance ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 采购订单与发票行应分别汇总到采购订单粒度再比较金额，不把付款粒度混入。

截止日前付款
mergeExamples.explanation: 发票1两笔付款合计5000，跨年付款排除。

mergeExamples.label: 完整付款核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留所有发票，识别四种状态。

mergeExamples.label: 采购订单金额核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 独立汇总采购行与发票行，避免两行乘两行。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH po(id,amount) AS (SELECT 1,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4000), inv(id,amount) AS (SELECT 1,3000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5000), a AS (SELECT id,SUM(amount) ordered FROM po GROUP BY id), b AS (SELECT id,SUM(amount) billed FROM inv GROUP BY id) SELECT a.id,ordered,billed,billed-ordered difference FROM a JOIN b ON a.id=b.id
